_note: The response body is whatever your gateway build emits for an auth rejection — assert the STATUS, not this shape.
_why_this_case_matters_most: A 200 here would not break the API. It would silently make per-app analytics impossible for this route, for every request captured while it stays that way — and no later query recovers identity the gateway never resolved. Of all the checks in this package, this is the one whose failure is both invisible and permanent.
_in_analytics: This request appears in analytics with NO app attribution, because identity never resolved. Expect it in an unidentified bucket. That is correct, not a gap — see tests/test-plan.yaml case per-app-attribution.
